set.body:
Scope

Expand external evidence without making ordinary portable tests depend on local R/Python installations.

Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every fixture states whether it proves HRF evaluation, design construction, fit/inference, or independent end-to-end behavior.
- [ ] HRF/design fixtures cover fmrihrf/fmridesign plus analytic cases; fit fixtures cover base R QR/WLS and configured fmrireg/Nilearn paths where relevant.
- [ ] End-to-end truth is not generated by the Scala compiler under test; solver-only fixtures are labelled as such.
- [ ] Receipts record schema version, command, source/package revisions, lock/environment identity, numerical conventions, matrix orientation, hashes, and accepted differences.
- [ ] Regeneration is deterministic and check mode detects stale JSON and generated Scala independently.
- [ ] Live regeneration runs in pinned nightly/release lanes; PR CI consumes checked-in portable fixtures.
- [ ] Comparisons include absolute/relative norm error, signed correlation, norm ratio, peak/integral timing where relevant, semantic alignment, rank/df, and log-p for extreme tails.
- [ ] No passing parity test uses post-hoc lag shifting or correlation alone.
- [ ] Disagreements are triaged by layer and cannot be hidden by globally enlarged tolerances.
- [ ] S06-S18 receipts and current active scenario receipts validate under the manifest gate.
set.title: P4.2: broaden external parity fixtures, receipts, and live regeneration lanes
